notes.title: 0.46 Demo patch notes
notes.content: [p]Demo 0.46 release patch notes[/p][p]Includes:[/p][p]* Improved readability of the Twist symbol by masking the tail on the opposite side.[/p]

notes.title: 0.45 Demo patch notes
notes.content: [p]0.45 Demo patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Added anti-aliasing settings to graphics sub-menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where mouse cursor was appearing on the wrong window after leaving pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]If graphics settings are not applied when leaving the graphics sub-menu they are reset.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled window resizing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where window size was not appearing on selected resolutions when game was running in a window.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.44 Demo patch notes
notes.content:
0.44 Demo patch notes:

[list]
[*]     Removed hidden press M to show mouse cursor feature.
[*]     Mouse cursor appears when you move mouse and hides when player moves.
[*]     Bug fix: When you're holding the undo button, it stops undoing when you undo a reset. 
[*]     If player presses space before movement has finished, puzzle in/out transition will occur if on a transition tile.
[*]     Update play testers list in demo credits.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.content:
I'm pleased to announce the [b]Trifoil demo[/b] is now [b]live on steam![/b]. Just in time for the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase hosted by Draknek and Friends! The showcase will run from May 29th to June 5th, and I'm excited that the Trifoil Demo will be part of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130613/5c7a45a069aa5ee0ac64165677c3d1469a12c355.png[/img]

I’m thrilled to have finally reached this milestone. Special thanks to all the playtesters, and to Grzegorz Bednorz for his fantastic work on the sound and music (and for reporting no end of bugs)!

Feedback welcome, join the Trifoil community, hop on the [url=https://discord.gg/ENGxJyZ84S]Discord[/url].

— Andrew

notes.title: Trifoil Demo is dropping May 28th!
notes.content:
I'm very pleased to announce that the [b]Trifoil Demo[/b] will be released at 9 PM AEST on May 28th, 2025. Just in time for the [url=https://www.cerebralpuzzleshowcase.com/]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/url] hosted by Draknek and Friends! The showcase will run from May 29th to June 5th, and I'm excited that the Trifoil Demo will be part of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130613/027f5884d19fd6162326ef71517a8332bd504e9f.png[/img]

Developing Trifoil has been quite a journey, so I’m thrilled to have reached this milestone. Special thanks to all the playtesters, and to Grzegorz Bednorz for his fantastic work on the sound and music (and for reporting no end of bugs)! ːsteamhappyː

To join the Trifoil community, hop on the [url=https://discord.gg/ENGxJyZ84S]Discord[/url].

Speak to you all on Wednesday when the demo goes live!

— Andrew
